$comment: TEMPLATE. Not read by anything. Copy, fill in real keys, and load it as
Never commit the filled-in version. .gitignore excludes s3_config.json in
this directory for exactly that reason.
Three identities, not one. The API issues pre-signed URLs and needs to
Write and Read. The worker writes archived event partitions and export
files. The retention sweep is the only identity that may Delete, because
a bug in the API must not be able to remove proctor media that an
integrity review is about to look at. Separating the delete capability
costs one more secret and removes a whole class of incident.
See docs/11-data-retention-and-dpia.md for what is deleted and when.
